text: {"label": "Child Safety, Care, and Early Development","definition": "Work on promoting young children's safety, care, and early development through caregiver, school, and community interventions, including infant care, public health approaches, underserved youth, and evidence-based practice evaluation.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Emphasizes safety, infant care, and public-health and community systems for children, rather than healthcare-setting disorder treatment, preschool skill building, or parent training methods specifically."}
